race.comment: MORIKAWA (4) brings the clear class edge after resuming in the Listed MAX SIMMONDS STAKES at Ascot, where he was beaten two and a half lengths by Big Red Zoom. Obviously looks very well placed back in Mdn company, and second-up he looks the horse they have to beat. SWING BAR (5) is the immediate danger after placing at both starts, including a long-neck second at this track when wide throughout, so there is genuine substance to his profile. SPIRIT OF DAN (9) resumes off a Belmont trial and showed enough in his first campaign, including a Pinjarra placing and a close sixth in Open company, to be a credible threat if forward enough. SUPER GOD (6) resumes today following a recent trial at Belmont Park, can figure in the finish.
